mu_name_from: MuMain's _enum.h: MONSTER_MODEL_SHADOW = 28, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster29.bmd; the server's type is MONSTER_SHADOW = 36. The client's name is 쉐도우, the English word in Hangul (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13883-13888). OpenMU's Version075 LostTower.cs:723-753 names number 36 'Shadow' at level 47 with 2800 health, 148-153 damage, 78 defense, MoveRange 3, AttackRange 1, ViewRange 5, AttackDelay 1400, no AttackSkill. 72 spots: 71 on Lost Tower 1, one on 2 (docs/lost-tower-port.md A §4.1).
rig_from:
Seven actions, slots 0 to 6, exported with --actions=0,1,2,3,4,5,6. Keys: 12, 12, 7, 6, 6, 6, 7. 54 bones, a biped's (Bip01) with three dummies and two sets of six claw bones, Box03-Box08 on the left upper arm and Box09-Box14 on the right. BoneHead = 5, Bip01 Head (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3614).

Play speeds are OpenMonsterModel's defaults with one override, `case MONSTER_MODEL_SHADOW: b->Actions[MONSTER01_WALK].PlaySpeed = 0.3f` (ZzzOpenData.cpp:2630), already in actions.json as "28": 0.3.
sheet_from: Two sheets, both .OZJ with no alpha: Data/Monster/shadow_c, 64 by 64, on the body (412 triangles), and shadow_b, 16 by 16, on one quad (2 triangles). Decoded under a shadow_ prefix. shadow_a.OZJ beside them is not read by Monster29.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheets at 4x. shadow_c: near-black plate in grey highlights -- rounded pauldrons with dark sockets, hexagonal panels, a ridged limb -- with a small orange ember painted at the lower left; dark lacquered armour, painted_steel as the Dark Knight's baron01. shadow_b: the same ember alone on black, one quad; the body's material, so it reads as part of the plate.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3607-3613: mShadow1, mShadow2, mShadowAttack1, mShadowAttack2 and mShadowDie, then SetMonsterSound(..., 113, 114, 115, 116, 117) -- offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210, so 323 SHADOW1 to 327 SHADOWDIE. Wired as shadow_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: 25 islands for 414 triangles, all plate: the sheet is armour throughout and its ember is paint on it, so every island takes painted_steel, the sheet's reading. They arrived as skin, the monster profile's default (islands.py never reads sheet_materials, as Larva01 records).
